pages.title: Air Fleet
pages.text: $(bold)Immersive Aircraft's heavy craft and upgrades: the cargo airship and the warship, the eco and nether engines, the steel boiler, reinforced hulls, landing gear and flight instruments, and the bomb bay, heavy crossbow and rotary cannon.$(br2)$(thing)Ashen Age$(n), ring 9.$(br)$(thing)39 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Aviator.
